races.race_name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Playtime
runners.spotlight: Leopardstown maiden hurdle winner (2m, soft) in March and runner-up to the smart Switch From Diesel in a Punchestown novice, his best run since; 2m6f may have stretched him last time, back in trip now.
runners.comment: 2m6f may have stretched him last time, back in trip now

runners.name: Mo Ghille Mar
runners.spotlight: Three Flat wins for Jessica Harrington and off the mark hurdling at eighth attempt in 2m1f Wexford handicap in May; runs since however have been modest, never counting on the flat here on Friday.
runners.comment: Hasn't built on Wexford win; never sighted on the flat here on Friday

runners.name: Coolboy Christy
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden but has shaped well on a few occasions, most notably when fourth at Leopardstown (2m2f, soft) in March; recent Wexford effort in first-time cheekpieces was okay, blinkers now tried.
runners.comment: Recent Wexford effort in first-time cheekpieces was okay, blinkers now tried

runners.name: Penzance
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old (one-time useful Flat handicapper) but runner-up on latest three starts in modest maiden hurdle company in Britain; twice at Stratford and most recently after making most (carrying head awkwardly, hung right) at Worcester (2m, good); handicap debut and doesn't exactly appear thrown in.
runners.comment: Runner-up in modest maidens of late; handicap debut and doesn't exactly appear thrown in

runners.name: Bannow Blaze
runners.spotlight: Wexford handicap winner last season at this trip (yielding); hasn't completed in both chase outings, well held when faller three out at Roscommon last time; back hurdling and opposable off this mark.
runners.comment: Casualty chasing of late; back hurdling and opposable off this mark

runners.name: Dream Shaper
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at 28th attempt when landing 2m3f Kilbeggan handicap last month, allowed to slip the field and win unchallenged; 9lb rise okay on the face of it, but not sure if he'll back that up and 3lb out of handicap here.
runners.comment: Slipped the field for Kilbeggan win; not sure if he'll back that up and 3lb wrong here

runners.name: Party President
runners.spotlight: Two-time hurdles winner last year; tame chase effort here on Tuesday and tried in first-time cheekpieces now back hurdling.
runners.comment: Tame chase effort here on Tuesday and tried in first-time cheekpieces back hurdling

runners.name: Timurshah
runners.spotlight: Thriving since joining current yard, making it 3-3 when scoring in emphatic fashion over C&D on Monday, despite taking a keen hold; hit with a 13lb rise for that so up an aggregate of 29lb since joining the yard; Conor Smithers has ridden him on all three wins and maintains the partnership here; big player.
runners.comment: Monday's C&D winner up 13lb but thriving and no surprise if he played a big role again

runners.name: Wahraan
runners.spotlight: In terrific form of late, winning 2m3f Market Rasen handicap hurdle in May (good) and returned from a short break when strong-finishing neck second (clear of remainder) of 19 in 2m1f flat handicap here on Wednesday; clearly handles the track, should go well.
runners.comment: Strong-finishing second in flat handicap here on Wednesday; big shout back hurdling

runners.name: Space Warrior
runners.spotlight: No success since a juvenile maiden hurdle win at Fairyhouse in November 2024; has dropped a long way in the ratings from an opening mark of 111 and, although recent Ballinrobe effort wasn't convincing, previous Clonmel third under today's rider offers hope; 1lb wrong.
runners.comment: Penultimate Clonmel third offers some hope now off a career-low mark
runners.owner: Mrs Helen Mullins & M J Lomax

runners.name: Torque De Lune
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced mare showed a bit of promise in a 2m3f Downpatrick mares maiden in June, but unseated in maiden at Killarney latest; handicap debut and others look more likely; 1lb wrong.
runners.comment: Unseated in maiden at Killarney latest; handicap debut and others look more likely

runners.name: Tassarolo
runners.spotlight: Back to form with good third in 1m4f Killarney flat handicap last month but unable to back that up at Ballinrobe five days later; 2-6 hurdling although poor handicap debut effort at Cork in April when last seen in that discipline.
runners.comment: Poor handicap debut effort at Cork in April, recent flat form patchy

runners.name: My Trump Card
runners.spotlight: Bumper and 2m4f maiden hurdle winner for Gordon Elliott but 0-7 chasing last season and debuts for new yard back over hurdles, over what appears an inadequate trip.
runners.comment: Ex-Gordon Elliott; debuts for new yard back over hurdles and trip looks inadequate

runners.name: Imperial Miss
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden went closest to scoring when just denied in a 2m6f novice handicap here last October (yielding) off 1lb higher; absent since December but on a nice mark and any market support could be significant, although drop in trip could be an issue.
runners.comment: Lacks a recent run but run here in October (2m6f) offers hope if handling drop in trip

runners.name: Cloonainra
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins at 2m2f but has lost her way since Listowel novice chase win in September; others in better form.
runners.comment: Lost her way since Listowel novice chase win in September; others in better form

runners.name: Barrys Spirit
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 5yo won 2m2f Downpatrick maiden for Gavin Cromwell last autumn before never counting in Grade 3 at Fairyhouse; back from eight months' absence on yard/handicap debut and probably best watched.
runners.comment: Unexposed 5yo entering handicap ranks but possibly best watched after 8 months off

runners.name: Castleheath
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner is 1-7 over timber, that win in a Punchestown maiden (2m1f, soft) last season; absent since poor run at Limerick over Christmas so watching brief advised, unless market speaks.
runners.comment: Absent since poor run at Limerick at Christmas, watching brief advised unless market talks

runners.name: Teed Up
runners.spotlight: Won this 2022 & 2023 and bids for third win on the back of a fine third of 20 in Connacht Hotel QR Handicap here on Monday, staying on well after not clear run; below best on flat here on Friday, questionable whether he'll turn out for a third time this week.
runners.comment: Bids for 3rd win in this race but well held on Friday on the flat, participation doubtful

races.race_name: Kenny Galway Peugeot Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Adaliz
runners.spotlight: Won twice last year, including over this trip at Tipperary off 95; has run just three times since, tame enough Downpatrick effort on latest; blinkers now replace cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Two comeback runs leave him with good bit to find; blinkers replace cheekpieces here

runners.name: Rocky's Howya
runners.spotlight: Has been making hay in claiming hurdles this year and has won five of his last seven starts, most recently over this trip at Roscommon last month; front-runner back in handicap company now and interesting to see if he can be as competitive off what appears a high enough mark.
runners.comment: Making hay in claiming hurdles of late; life likely more difficult back in a handicap

runners.name: High Court Cave
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in 2m6f handicap at last year's festival before winning 2m2f maiden at Downpatrick (yielding); has struggled a bit since in handicaps and others look better handicapped right now.
runners.comment: Runner-up at this meeting last year but recent form is modest enough

runners.name: Wild Mandate
runners.spotlight: First reserve; improved for step up in trip in landing 3m2f Sligo handicap last month, just holding on after being clear for much of the way (Justatan 17l away third, fourth went close here during the week); 6lb rise seems okay, could go well if getting a run.
runners.comment: Relished stamina test for 3m2f Sligo win; 6lb rise okay, could go well; reserve

runners.name: Sallap
runners.spotlight: Progressive mare has won three of last four completed outings, including last two in 2m6f handicaps at Clonmel and when defying 7lb rise at Limerick last month in ready fashion to win going away; up a further 9lb so more needed but quite possible.
runners.comment: Hat-trick seeking mare up 9lb for recent Limerick success; respected

runners.name: Reiki Revolution
runners.spotlight: Bumper and 2m4f maiden (Punchestown) hurdle winner; unseated two out when shaping with promise on first two chase efforts, most recently completed but again let down by jumping at Wexford; reverts to hurdles here, placings over this trip in maidens.
runners.comment: Jumping has let him down chasing of late; don't dismiss back hurdling

runners.name: Fou De Toi
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 5yo ran once in France and still looks a work in progress after four starts for champion trainer, tight 2m4f in Wexford maiden last time may not have been ideal; bit to prove but improvement quite likely back at 3m.
runners.comment: Still looks a work in progress but return to 3m should suit

runners.name: Tullyveery Lad
runners.spotlight: 5-40 under rules, three of those have come in chases, the latest at Tramore last summer (2m6f, good); yet to hit form this year although recent 9l second to Rocky's Howya in 3m Roscommon claiming hurdle was a step in the right direction and enjoys an 8lb pull in the weights with that rival back in handicap company.
runners.comment: Second to Rocky's Howya in 3m Roscommon claiming hurdle latest; 8lb better off here
runners.owner: Pat Tennyson & N P Morrissey & Raymond Micheal Cody

runners.name: Justatan
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in two point-to-points for Michael Goff; mild promise in maiden hurdles, most recently stayed on late into modest third (to Wild Mandate) in 3m2f Sligo handicap last month (good); cheekpieces now added and could be dangerous off light weight under a more positive ride.
runners.comment: Sligo third stays well; cheekpieces added and could be dangerous off light weight

runners.name: Mr Master Mac
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; off mark at second attempt over hurdles in 2m3f Downpatrick maiden in May (good), following month tame enough effort in handicap over same C&D; back from a short break and tries a new trip.
runners.comment: Back from a short break and tries a new trip; remains relatively unexposed

runners.name: Stormbreaker
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner for Willie Mullins ran well in some handicaps; pulled up on yard debut after some 14 months' absence at Sligo recently; probably best watched for now.
runners.comment: Pulled up on yard debut after some 14 months' absence at Sligo; probably best watched

runners.name: Forceonmyown
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point and bumper winner; 0-5 hurdling, unconvincing upped in trip (2m7f) at Clonmel when last seen in April.
runners.comment: 0-5 hurdling, unconvincing upped in trip (2m7f) at Clonmel when last seen in April

runners.name: Elusive Ogie
runners.spotlight: Limerick maiden winner last year and finished good third in the Lartigue at Listowel; easily best run since and just beginning his challenge (going well) when unseating two out at Killarney in May, most recently would have gone closer but for pecking two out at same venue last month over 2m7f; remains of interest; also due to run here yeasterday (3.12).
runners.comment: Would have gone closer but for pecking two out at Killarney; remains of interest

runners.name: Caher Roes Den
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; 0-6 hurdling in Britain for Ben Brookhouse, yard debut (after long absence) in 2m6f Downpatrick handicap last month was encouraging enough and worth another shot at this trip, especially on better ground.
runners.comment: Encouraging enough recent yard debut; potential improver back at 3m

runners.name: Fair Damsel
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; won 2m1f maiden at Killarney in 2024; fairly lightly raced since but recent form not that encouraging; lots more needed.
runners.comment: Recent form not that encouraging, lots more needed; reserve

runners.name: Sir Allen
runners.spotlight: Returned from long layoff with decisive Flat win at Navan in March (heavy); okay runs both starts since in handicap hurdles but lot more needed and takes a big step up in trip.
runners.comment: Good bit more needed on recent form and takes a big step up in trip

runners.name: Beggars Rock
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been at around 2m5f, including Kilbeggan beginners' chase last year; just okay run on latest in Wexford handicap hurdle over this trip in May; stamina remains a possible issue.
runners.comment: Wins over shorter; stamina remains a possible issue

runners.name: Pinot Rouge
runners.spotlight: Both wins in Britain came at around this trip on easy ground; best effort for some time on latest when front-running second in 3m Hexham handicap in June for Susan Corbett; debuts for new trainer who had a good second on the flat here on Wednesday.
runners.comment: Recent Hexham second debuts for new trainer who had a second on the flat here on Wednesday

runners.name: Mento
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 4yo ran twice in bumpers before debut hurdles win in 2m3f Kilbeggan maiden in May (good-to-yielding); soon beaten in good-class 2m1f novice here on Monday and now takes a big step up in trip for handicap debut.
runners.comment: Soon beaten in good-class 2m1f novice here on Monday; big step up in trip for handicap bow

runners.name: Pat Coyne
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; veteran whose five wins include three at Tramore; back from spell in point-to-points off career-low mark.
runners.comment: Tramore specialist; back from spell in point-to-points off career-low mark; reserve

races.race_name: Kinlay Hostel Handicap Chase

runners.name: Ira Hayes
runners.spotlight: Lucky to win a Tramore beginners' but then ran well in Market Rasen handicap; lapped at Perth and back from a break here.
runners.comment: Lucky to win a Tramore beginners' but then ran well in Market Rasen handicap

runners.name: Smallcraftwarning
runners.spotlight: Mixes it between chasing and hurdling; consistent last year including C&D second over fences; a little less predictable lately, but couple of good runs at Limerick and jockey booking is noted.
runners.comment: Consistent last year including C&D second over fences; a little less predictable lately

runners.name: Journey So Far
runners.spotlight: Dotted up from the front in a Tramore beginners' over this trip and has been freshened up since.
runners.comment: Dotted up from the front in a Tramore beginners' over this trip and been freshened up

runners.name: Le Grand Vert
runners.spotlight: Hard enough to predict but has won four handicap chases, latest over 3m1f at Punchestown in June; first visit to Galway and he's ground-versatile.
runners.comment: Hard enough to predict but has won four handicap chases, latest over 3m1f at Punchestown

runners.name: Inchidaly Copper
runners.spotlight: Family horse has won thrice over fences; has handled Tramore, so he might be okay around here; hurdling off lower marks lately and comes here in good shape.
runners.comment: Family horse has won thrice over fences, has handled Tramore, so might be okay around here

runners.name: Mistyburn
runners.spotlight: Point and 3m hurdles winner was around 20l off Le Grand Vert on handicap chase debut at Punchestown (3m1f); still early days for him in this discipline.
runners.comment: Point and 3m hurdles winner was around 20l off Le Grand Vert on handicap chase debut

runners.name: Saunton Surf
runners.spotlight: Won a point and seems to have improved markedly for having fences back in front of her; won a Downpatrick restricted beginners' by 10l and the runner-up won a handicap by the same margin next time; stays farther and plenty to like.
runners.comment: Won a Downpatrick beginners' by 10l and runner-up won a handicap by same margin next time

runners.name: Sammy Smart
runners.spotlight: Had decent form in the winter, and stays 3m, but has been struggling of late; place chance if he bounces back, and yard has had three run well here this week.
runners.comment: Place chance if he bounces back, and yard has had three run well here this week

runners.name: Soldante
runners.spotlight: Generally runs at around 2m and won at Roscommon before running well in hurdle here on Monday; stamina for new trip is the imponderable.
runners.comment: Generally runs at around 2m and won at Roscommon, before running well in hurdle here
runners.owner: P McCormack & David P McCormack & Sarah Glynn

runners.name: Gorthill
runners.spotlight: Four point wins and snared a maiden hunter chase three years ago, but hard to fancy in a competitive handicap.
runners.comment: Won a maiden hunter chase three years ago, but hard to fancy in a competitive handicap

runners.name: Lawful Ruler
runners.spotlight: Nothing to recommend him since winning 3m hunter chase at Cork over Easter; first handicap.
runners.comment: Nothing to recommend him since winning 3m hunter chase at Cork over Easter; first handicap

runners.name: Prince Palace
runners.spotlight: Landed a nice pot on heavy ground at Navan over a year ago but form has deteriorated since; long way off Golden Temple last time.
runners.comment: Landed a nice pot on heavy ground at Navan over a year ago but form has deteriorated since

runners.name: Jukebox Johnny
runners.spotlight: Not much as a hurdler, but was second in sole point and again on chase debut over this trip in Limerick handicap where tongue-tie did him no harm; top yard and rider, and can improve again.
runners.comment: Second in sole point and again on chase debut over this trip in Limerick handicap
runners.owner: Anthony N Durkan & B M Durkan

runners.name: Noble Talent
runners.spotlight: Decent winter performer as a novice a couple of years ago, but his form has fallen off a cliff, with his mark still clinging on to the precipice; blinkers made no odds last time.
runners.comment: Decent winter performer a couple of years ago, but his form has fallen off a cliff

runners.name: Kings Jet
runners.spotlight: Hunter chase winner only made it to the first when 25s for handicap debut at Wexford.
runners.comment: Hunter chase winner only made it to the first when 25s for handicap debut at Wexford.

runners.name: Golden Temple
runners.spotlight: Has hit form with a chase win over 2m4f at Kilbeggan nine days ago and a belting run over hurdles (2m6f) here on Wednesday; every chance.
runners.comment: Chase win over 2m4f at Kilbeggan and a belting run over hurdles (2m6f) here on Wednesday

runners.name: Drop A Threat
runners.spotlight: A lot of Gigginstown's have been taking flight from Mullins' yard lately, and this modest performer will probably be on his way to Doncaster sales, rather than Elliott's, before long; did plug away over 2m2f when sixth of 20 here on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Modest performer, but he did plug away over 2m2f when sixth of 20 here on Tuesday

runners.name: Riggs
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over farther last summer, but old boy is hard to recommend on recent evidence.
runners.comment: Dual winner over farther last summer, but old boy hard to recommend on recent evidence
runners.owner: Paul M Butler & James Patrick Byrne

races.race_name: Lord Hemphill Memorial Handicap Chase

runners.name: Le Nez Creux
runners.spotlight: Cost plenty from France where she was a dual chase winner and fair fifth in a 4yo Grade 1 over 2m6f; ran well on stable debut at Ayr in April where 2m looked too sharp; a most interesting contender, and similarly interesting riding arrangement; could have a class edge over most of these, if she's right.
runners.comment: Cost plenty from France where she was a dual chase winner; good run on yard debut at Ayr

runners.name: War Correspondent
runners.spotlight: Quirky customer won over fences at Wexford last summer and is unexposed as a chaser; okay run over hurdles last time, and small chance if they've got his confidence back (didn't want to know about jumping on his last run over fences).
runners.comment: Quirky customer won over fences at Wexford last summer and is unexposed as a chaser

runners.name: Blood Destiny
runners.spotlight: Handicap mark has been remarkably static for the past two years and he's just in that 'twilight zone' where he's difficult to place; they don't often run him in handicap chases and he's been pulled up the twice he's tried; beatable under a hefty impost.
runners.comment: They don't often run him in handicap chases and he's been pulled up the twice he's tried

runners.name: Drumgill
runners.spotlight: Won a nice pot over 2m1f at Fairyhouse in November, but it's been all downhill since and he's now 4lb lower than that last winning mark.
runners.comment: Won a nice pot over 2m1f at Fairyhouse in November, but it's been all downhill since

runners.name: Lisleigh Lad
runners.spotlight: Dual winning hunter has taken well to handicaps and the form of his fluent-jumping Wexford win is very solid; second was only beaten 7l in the Plate and third almost won next time; stays farther, but might just prefer an easier finish than this punishing climb.
runners.comment: Form of his fluent-jumping Wexford win is very solid; might just prefer an easier finish

runners.name: The Banger Doyle
runners.spotlight: Latest of three wins over fences was in 2024, but ran well on the flat a couple of times this summer and chasing second at Killarney was encouraging too; Danny Mullins on board for just the second time.
runners.comment: Twice ran well on the flat lately and chasing second at Killarney was encouraging too

runners.name: Bythesametoken
runners.spotlight: Owned by Galway people but hasn't clicked here yet, although has run well over hurdles at this venue;  last win was over similar trip at last year's Listowel festival, but 8lb higher now because he's well out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Owned by Galway people but hasn't clicked here yet, although has run well over hurdles

runners.name: Itsalladream
runners.spotlight: Course maiden hurdle winner was over-faced several times over fences after winning a Roscommon novice which fell apart last summer; has the beating of Blood Destiny on Listowel running two runs back, and little wrong with his 6l fourth to Lisleigh Lad on handicap debut at Wexford, where he didn't quite see it out over a furlong farther.
runners.comment: Was over-faced a few times but ran well in Wexford handicap when 6l off Lisleigh Lad

runners.name: Coming Up Easy
runners.spotlight: Was flying it in handicap chases last year, from an opening perch of 116; jumping went to pot when only 13-2 for Cheltenham's Paddy Power and tailed off in Topham in April; not sure to appreciate the contours of this track, but trip will suit if he handles it.
runners.comment: Was flying it in handicap chases last year; not sure to appreciate these undulations

runners.name: Path d'Oroux
runners.spotlight: Poor strike rate over fences and has been beaten miles in his last three handicaps; well held over Hurdles here yesterday.
runners.comment: Poor strike rate over fences and has been beaten miles in his last three handicaps

runners.name: Watch The Weather
runners.spotlight: Disappointing in Mayo National at Ballinrobe and held by a couple of these on latest Wexford fifth; crack conditional being on board will help his chance, and is back down to a nice mark.
runners.comment: Disappointing in Mayo National and held by a couple of these on latest Wexford fifth

runners.name: Runcok
runners.spotlight: Winner over hurdles and fences in these colours when with Willie Mullins; last three runs have been poor, including stable debut hurdling; hood back on but yet to convince with his jumping (can go left); handicap debut.
runners.comment: Last three runs have been poor, including stable debut hurdling; jumping can be iffy

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)

runners.name: Greydreambeliever
runners.spotlight: First reserve; doesn't have the winning habit, but a couple of near misses over this trip for current yard; beaten 7l in C&D Listed contest on Thursday.
runners.comment: Doesn't have the winning habit; beaten 7l in C&D Listed contest on Thursday; reserve
runners.owner: K Blake/Mrs E Palmer/M Wilson/N Luck

runners.name: Unique Journey
runners.spotlight: Good record over 6f on straight tracks and on easy ground; was second in C&D nursery at two, but there will probably be stronger finishers up the hill; jockey is one to watch.
runners.comment: Good record over 6f on straight tracks and on easy ground; second in C&D nursery at two
runners.owner: N W T Dalzell/James Morgan/Karl Kirwan/Mrs John Murphy

runners.name: Dark Ace
runners.spotlight: Progressive and consistent sprinter until latest run at the Curragh; 6f looks his optimum; placed effort over 7f on AW doesn't mean he's sure to get up the hill here.
runners.comment: Progressive and consistent sprinter until latest run at the Curragh; 6f looks his optimum
runners.owner: J Fairhurst & Damian McCann & Cyril McMullan

runners.name: Dos Mukasan
runners.spotlight: Four wins in France, including AW Listed contest over 7f; 50s, showed nothing in first two Irish starts.
runners.comment: Four wins in France, including Listed race; 50s, showed nothing in first two Irish starts

runners.name: Lir Speciale
runners.spotlight: First reserve; only 7s when beaten 8l behind Orandi over 1m here on Tuesday, weakening up the hill; good record over this trip, though, and ground-versatile, so not one to dismiss.
runners.comment: Only 7s when beaten 8l behind Orandi over 1m here on Tuesday; 7f will suit better; reserve

runners.name: Lord Massusus
runners.spotlight: Yard stalwart weakened right out of it behind Orandi here on Tuesday and hard to fancy; tongue-tie tried.
runners.comment: Yard stalwart weakened right out of it behind Orandi here on Tuesday and hard to fancy

runners.name: Pierre Royal
runners.spotlight: Unexposed and progressive; won well at the Curragh on Derby weekend and fine second to Orandi when favourite here on Tuesday; had a decent run through then, and no real excuses; first time to drop back to 7f, and it's not sure to suit him as well as a mile.
runners.comment: Fine second to Orandi when favourite here on Tuesday; first time to drop back to 7f

runners.name: Glory To Be
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; dual handicap winner over this trip in 2026, but stepping into this grade of competition found her out at the Curragh.
runners.comment: Dual handicap winner over this trip in 2026, but this grade may be beyond her; reserve

runners.name: Jagged Edge
runners.spotlight: All wins over 1m and was outpaced in the dip when third here on Tuesday; wide trip means that effort can be marked up, but 7f could be a bit sharp for him.
runners.comment: All wins over 1m and was outpaced in the dip when third here on Tuesday; 7f may be sharp

runners.name: Dunum
runners.spotlight: Course specialist won this in 2023 and third in last two renewals; lacked a prep outing before his run here on Tuesday where he backpedalled tamely; draw has been kind for one with his run-style, but he's pushing on and looks opposable.
runners.comment: Course specialist won this in 2023 and third in last two renewals; faded here on Tuesday

runners.name: Far From Dandy
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in two runs at last year's festival and fell out of the traps when always behind over 1m here on Tuesday; looks risky after that and best form is at a mile.
runners.comment: Fell out of the traps when always behind over 1m here on Tuesday; looks risky after that

runners.name: Vafortino
runners.spotlight: Well-travelled and well-exposed 8yo is a long time winless; was running in stakes races in Dubai during the winter; held in handicap company in Britain last twice.
runners.comment: Well-travelled and well-exposed 8yo is a long time winless; held in handicaps last twice
runners.owner: D MacAuliffe, Anoj Don and Dahab Racing

runners.name: City House
runners.spotlight: Yet to win for this yard, but handicapper slow enough to relent; fair fourth to Gleneagle Bay at Cork in June; first time here, which will be an eye-opener for him.
runners.comment: Yet to win for this yard, but handicapper slow enough to relent;  first time to run here

runners.name: Dorset
runners.spotlight: Smart 2yo mostly relegated to pacemaking duties this season, although penultimate start in Curragh Group 2 was decent; last in the Sussex on Wednesday having done his job, and is the complete opposite of one who has been laid out for this.
runners.comment: Smart 2yo mostly relegated to pacemaking duties this season; last in Group 1 at Goodwood

runners.name: Genuine Article
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m here last year, in lower grade; well beaten behind Orandi and co here on Tuesday and hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Won over 1m here last year, in lower grade; well beaten behind Orandi here on Tuesday

runners.name: Gleneagle Bay
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner but got it done over this trip at Cork and was strong-travelling second in this last year; luckless run when sixth over 1m here on Tuesday and the 'champ' takes over in the saddle.
runners.comment: Strong-travelling second in this in 2025; luckless run when sixth over 1m here on Tuesday

runners.name: Orandi
runners.spotlight: Got all the gaps down the inner when winning the big 1m handicap here on Tuesday, with seven of these behind; has loads of gears and likely to be ridden similarly from widest draw; 7lb penalty.
runners.comment: Got all the gaps down the inner when winning the big 1m handicap here on Tuesday; up 7lb

races.race_name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Seaxburh
runners.spotlight: The most experienced of these and runner-up over 7f at right-handed tracks last twice; obvious chance.
runners.comment: The most experienced of these and runner-up over 7f at right-handed tracks last twice

runners.name: Star Glory
runners.spotlight: Improved from Curragh debut to be close second over this trip at Leopardstown (first three were clear and third has gone in since); has given trouble in the stalls, but was better in that regard last time.
runners.comment: Improved from Curragh debut to be close second over this trip at Leopardstown

runners.name: Someday Somewhere
runners.spotlight: Was 9s and quietly fancied when third at Leopardstown on debut, 2l in front of Whosinterviewinwho; winner was different gravy, but it was still a decent start to her career.
runners.comment: Was 9s and quietly fancied when third at Leopardstown, 2l in front of Whosinterviewinwho

runners.name: Oristown Boy
runners.spotlight: Looked as green as grass before flying home from rear (fully 12l off the pace 2f out) to be beaten less than a length at Down Royal on second start; definitely has an engine and the hill will suit.
runners.comment: Flew home from rear (fully 12l off the pace 2f out) at Down Royal on second start
runners.owner: Ms Lisa Sheridan & Patrick M O'Brien & Larry Murray

runners.name: Whosinterviewinwho
runners.spotlight: Late headway when two places, and two lengths, off Someday Somewhere at Leopardstown where the winner was in a different county; not out of this.
runners.comment: Late headway when two places, and two lengths, off Someday Somewhere at Leopardstown

runners.name: Gabby Hayes
runners.spotlight: Space Traveller newcomer cost 8,000euro as a yearling; half-brother to three winners out of 7f AW winner; very much the second string for yard.
runners.comment: Half-brother to three winners out of 7f AW winner; very much the second string for yard

runners.name: Miss Cornelia
runners.spotlight: Had run in a barrier trial before sixth at Leopardstown, where she was off the bridle before the straight over 7f; wants farther, but will be keeping on up the hill.
runners.comment: Sixth over 7f at Leopardstown, where she was off the bridle before the straight

runners.name: Hypiradon
runners.spotlight: 66s when around 9l behind runner-up Star Glory at Leopardstown last month.
runners.comment: 66s when around 9l behind runner-up Star Glory at Leopardstown last month

runners.name: Dakota Jack
runners.spotlight: Yet to beat a rival and gets a mark after this.
runners.comment: Yet to beat a rival and gets a mark after this

runners.name: Scotty Cameron
runners.spotlight: 50s, no show at Leopardstown last month.
runners.comment: 50s, no show at Leopardstown last month

races.race_name: Village Salthill Handicap

runners.name: Cisterna
runners.spotlight: Roscommon winner on good ground with just okay form since off 5lb higher; bit to find with Jp's Express on latest Fairyhouse run. although has been dropped 2lb.
runners.comment: Bit to find with Jp's Express on latest Fairyhouse run although has been dropped 2lb

runners.name: Felix Somary
runners.spotlight: Debut 6f maiden win at Sligo last August sole success from seven starts, although recent Navan third (1m2f) under a positive ride was more encouraging; visor now replaces cheekpieces and drops in trip; could go well if handling softer ground.
runners.comment: Navan third drops in trip and could go well if handling softer ground

runners.name: Jp's Express
runners.spotlight: Eyecatching third at Fairyhouse and backed that up by winning over C&D on Friday in first-time cheekpieces, asserting late on on yielding-to-soft; major chance if making quick return under mandatory 7lb penalty, although wide draw to contend with.
runners.comment: Asserted late over C&D on Friday; major chance if turning out again but wide draw

runners.name: Iamimmaculate
runners.spotlight: Claimed after Naas success last September and fine yard debut effort following month when second in Leopardstown nursery; seemingly ridden to stay 1m2f trip on seasonal return at Roscommon in late June, staying on into fourth under today's rider; back in trip here but softer ground will suit and can go well.
runners.comment: Encouraging seasonal return; back in trip here but softer ground will suit and can go well

runners.name: Mr Ballynonty
runners.spotlight: Promising Navan debut run (1m2f, yielding) hasn't been replicated in two starts since, not getting home last time over 1m4f; back markedly in trip here for handicap debut with Billy Lee booked.
runners.comment: Back markedly in trip here for handicap debut with Billy Lee booked

runners.name: Aquilla Star
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a heavy ground nursery here last October and again when only caught late by Nephin Mountain over 1m2f at Ballinrobe recently, having handled home turn much better than that rival; well below that form in first-time cheekpieces over C&D on Friday however, having not had a clear run.
runners.comment: Denied by Nephin Mountain at Ballinrobe; well held over C&D on Friday behind Jp's Express

runners.name: Snow Princess
runners.spotlight: Improvement since switched from AW, third in Leopardstown maiden (yielding-to-soft) and never-nearer fifth on handicap debut at Gowran, both over 1m; remains open to more improvement.
runners.comment: Encouraging enough handicap debut at Gowran; softer ground could now suit

runners.name: Into Tomorrow
runners.spotlight: Mildly promising Cork debut in May but two poor runs since; 4lb wrong on handicap debut, but rider's claim negates that.
runners.comment: Not an obvious one and 4lb wrong on handicap debut but rider's claim negates that

runners.name: Blue Blue Moon
runners.spotlight: Debuted at Listed level last year and hasn't really got competitive in both maidens this term, latest in steadily-run 1m4f Limerick fillies' contest last month; back in trip here for handicap debut with likely more to offer.
runners.comment: Not competitive in maidens this term; back in trip for handicap debut

runners.name: Nephin Mountain
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eleventh attempt when just getting up to beat Aquilla Star at Ballinrobe (1m2f) last month, having run wide home turn; 4lb wrong here and wide draw to overcome.
runners.comment: Just got up to beat Aquilla Star at Ballinrobe; back in trip, 4lb wrong and wide draw

runners.name: Unfamiliar
runners.spotlight: Just held on over 7f at Limerick two starts back; never counted (tight for room early on) here on Monday and of limited appeal from 3lb out of handicap.
runners.comment: Never counted (tight for room early) here on Monday; 3lb wrong and of limited appeal

races.race_name: Fr. Breen Memorial (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners.name: Linford
runners.spotlight: Masked Marvel gelding a decisive winner of both bumpers, at Killarney in May and on softer ground at Roscommon following month (beating subsequent winner Caislean Gear), both times racing prominently; major prospects of completing the hat-trick here.
runners.comment: 2-2 in bumpers, major chance of completing the hat-trick

runners.name: Reafadda
runners.spotlight: Cheaply bought Wings Of Eagles gelding is half-brother to winners Good to Talk (French 5f-1m1f inc 2yo/AW; RPR 80) and Cable (2m hurdle/2m2f chase); dam unraced half-sister to US 1m Grade 1 winner Price Tag; stiff enough debut against four previous winners.
runners.comment: Cheaply bought Wings Of Eagles gelding; stiff enough debut against four previous winners

runners.name: Caislean Gear
runners.spotlight: Chased home Linford on Roscommon debut in June and off the mark at third attempt when making all on better ground at Killarney in what looked an ordinary contest; good bit more likely required but going the right way.
runners.comment: Made all at Killarney last month; good bit to find with Linford on Roscommon debut run

runners.name: The Two Mary's
runners.spotlight: Affinisea filly hasn't completed in two point-to-points; can only be watched on rules debut.
runners.comment: Affinisea filly hasn't completed in two point-to-points; best watched on rules debut

runners.name: Back In Favour
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Win Some Lose Some (useful 2m3f-2m7f hurdle) and Don'tstopbelievin (point); point-to-point winner (sixth attempt) in May before staying on into midfield on bumper debut at Roscommon; lots of improvement needed.
runners.comment: Midfield on bumper debut at Roscommon; lots of improvement needed

runners.name: Mindyourheadmike
runners.spotlight: Never counted on Bellewstown debut in April but following month huge improvement to score at Clonmel when allowed to dictate (good-to-yielding), trained then by Terence O'Brien; bought for 42,000GBP a week later and debuts for new trainer.
runners.comment: Bought for 42,000GBP a week after Clonmel success; debuts for new trainer

races.race_name: Radnor Hills Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Charmaine
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been on the AW (1m/1m4f) but she's a consistent mare with comparable form on turf and should give her running once more (second on previous visit here); chance.
runners.comment: Three AW wins; yet to win on turf but has comparable form; likeably consistent

runners.name: L'Eagle Aid
runners.spotlight: One of three wins came over C&D in July of last year (promoted after dead-heating); solid runs in his last three races, two at Chester; tactically versatile and should be in the mix; first-time headgear.
runners.comment: C&D winner who is tactically versatile; solid runs in his last three races

runners.name: Level Look
runners.spotlight: Progressed last year to win a 1m2f novice at Newcastle (AW); last of four on handicap debut at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) but that was after a break of 189 days and he's fully entitled to strip fitter for that; yard's runners always respected around here.
runners.comment: 2yo winner who could be a lot sharper for his handicap debut at Newmarket

runners.name: Timber Twelve
runners.spotlight: Record of 3-5 and it was his first time at 1m4f when making all for a convincing win at Epsom a month ago (good); that race couldn't have worked out better for him and he could be pressured this time if going from the front, but he looks progressive; up 6lb.
runners.comment: It was his first time at 1m4f when making all for a convincing win at Epsom; raised 6lb

runners.name: Patagonia Girl
runners.spotlight: Six visits here have yielded two wins and as many thirds; below her best over an extended 1m2f in last two races (also here) but she's back to Class 4 level in which she made all over C&D in May off only 2lb lower; considered, for all that an easy leads seems unlikely.
runners.comment: She's back to Class 4 level in which she made all over C&D in May off only 2lb lower

runners.name: Kuredu King
runners.spotlight: Won 11.6f and 1m6f handicaps last year for the Gosden yard; two heavy defeats over hurdles to start off with for current one but he was a 5l fourth of nine over 2m here in May and he was held up in a small field when never threatening at Newmarket last time (1m6f); back here, on a realistic mark, he could feature.
runners.comment: Ran quite well here in May and subsequent Newmarket defeat is easily forgiven

runners.name: Westerton
runners.spotlight: Nearly won over hurdles in May but two lesser runs followed and now 0-7 in that scene, while he's only 1-21 on the Flat (for Alan King); on a useful mark but probably not as good as he was, and he's unraced at Chester.
runners.comment: On a useful mark but probably not as good as he was; has been hurdling

races.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF "Confined" Maiden Stakes (Three Runs Or Less) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Pure Grit
runners.spotlight: Promising second at Newbury (6f, good) in May and ran to a similar level when second over C&D two weeks later; absent for nine weeks since but he sets a clear standard and still has more to offer.
runners.comment: Runner-up in two 6f events in May; absent nine weeks but this looks a good opening

runners.name: Shakwaa
runners.spotlight: 210,000gns yearling; palpably green when third of ten on his debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month but he kept on steadily in the closing stages; open to improvement and he's a key player.
runners.comment: Needed the experience but shaped well when third at Newbury last month; capable of better

runners.name: Sovereigns High
runners.spotlight: Stayed on for third in a maiden at Kempton (6f) in June; unable to build on it at Windsor three weeks ago; others are stronger.
runners.comment: Debut third hasn't worked out and he failed to build on it at Windsor three weeks ago

runners.name: Independent Roze
runners.spotlight: 100-1 and offered little short-term promise at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) in June.
runners.comment: 100-1 and offered little short-term promise at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) in June

runners.name: Therewearethen
runners.spotlight: Poor form in two AW (7f/6f) runs this summer; can't recommend.
runners.comment: Poor form in two AW (7f/6f) runs this summer; can't recommend

races.race_name: Queensferry Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Simplify
runners.spotlight: Progressive this year before struggling in the Palace Of Holyroodhouse at Royal Ascot 44 days ago; won't mind stepping back up to 6f but a big personal best will be needed to win.
runners.comment: Below par at Royal Ascot latest but she had been on the up beforehand

runners.name: Fitzella
runners.spotlight: Kept good company as a 2yo, winning Group 3 Princess Margaret Stakes at Ascot (6f, good); unplaced in four runs this year but her close fifth in the Commonwealth Cup was a personal best; down the field at York last month but she raced alone towards the stands' side and that isn't the run to judge her on; big player.
runners.comment: Group 3 win as a 2yo; good run in Royal Ascot Group 1 and had an excuse latest; big player

runners.name: Calico Blue
runners.spotlight: Progressive sprinter; chased home Jazl in a Newmarket handicap last month (2lb worse off today) before improving his flawless C&D record to 3-3 with an easy win eight days ago; worth his place in this stronger company and he looks sure to go well once again.
runners.comment: Progressive sprinter who extended his unbeaten C&D record to three last week; more to come

runners.name: Jazl
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in both 2yo starts; gelded prior to his reappearance at Windsor (6f, good to firm) and he showed his true colours, recording a comfortable success; followed up in a Leicester handicap in May and was a leading fancy for the Palace Of Holyroodhouse at Royal Ascot, only to completely blow out; back on the up with a hard-fought neck defeat of Calico Blue at Newmarket last month; remains a sprinter of interest.
runners.comment: A flop at Royal Ascot the only blot on his 2026 record; remains capable of better; solid

runners.name: Rock On Thunder
runners.spotlight: Chased home Lifeplan in the Gimcrack last August; well beaten in Group 2/Group 1 events so far this year; this drop in class could revive his fortunes but he is up against some progressive sorts.
runners.comment: Second to Lifeplan in last year's Gimcrack; struggled in stronger company so far this year
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Lifeplan
runners.spotlight: 2-2 as a 2yo, following his debut success in a novice at Thirsk (6f, good) with a ready win in the Group 2 Gimcrack at York (6f, good to firm) last August; that form hasn't worked out and his subsequent absence is a slight concern; has the highest BHA rating in the field but he's drawn widest and there are grounds for taking him on.
runners.comment: 2-2 as a 2yo, including Group 2 Gimcrack; absent 345 days and drawn widest

runners.name: Sirius A
runners.spotlight: Didn't need to improve on his 2yo form to win a conditions event at Wolverhampton (6f) in April; backward steps twice since and he needs a subsequent gelding operation to spark improvement.
runners.comment: Not at best on last two starts; gelded since; others have stronger form

runners.name: Song Of The Clyde
runners.spotlight: Won a valuable sales race at last season's Ebor meeting; improved performer this year, winning a Listed event at Newbury (6f, good) before a close seventh in the Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; disappointed at Newbury two weeks ago when reportedly finding the ground too fast; a penalty could leave him vulnerable today.
runners.comment: Disappointed last time but earlier efforts read well; could prove vulnerable under penalty
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Cxx & M Parker

runners.name: Ardisia
runners.spotlight: Five wins in a busy 2yo campaign, notably the Listed Two-Year-Old Trophy at Redcar (6f, good to soft) in October; retains ability but others bring stronger claims.
runners.comment: Prolific as a 2yo but no progress this year; vulnerable to improvers

races.race_name: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap

runners.name: Dance In The Storm
runners.spotlight: Produced a smart turn of foot to defy a wide draw in a C&D handicap in May; unplaced twice since but her potential hasn't been dimmed, looking stretched by the trip on rain-softened ground at Epsom and then doing best of her group at Royal Ascot; drawn widest again but this mark is unlikely to prove beyond her.
runners.comment: Overcame wide draw over C&D in May; excuses twice since; remains a handicapper of interest

runners.name: Power Fizz
runners.spotlight: Three 7f wins in 2025; impressive dropped to 6f at Newcastle in March but he disappointed as favourite back at Newcastle five weeks ago; the penultimate performance suggests this mark is well within his range, and he could resume his progress back at 7f.
runners.comment: Impressed over 6f on AW in March; disappointing latest but he still has potential

runners.name: Roman Dragon
runners.spotlight: Eight course wins to his name, the latest in May (5f, good) off a 2lb lower mark; had form over 7f in his youth but this year's two C&D runs haven't been convincing.
runners.comment: Multiple course winner over shorter; this year's C&D efforts don't suggest he's the answer

runners.name: Khafiz
runners.spotlight: Yet to win a handicap but he is easing down the weights and his stable debut at York (1m, good to firm) was encouraging; well drawn back at 7f and he's one to consider.
runners.comment: Not won a handicap but last month's stable debut was encouraging; return to 7f a plus

runners.name: Monarch's Gold
runners.spotlight: Won twice on AW (6f) as a 2yo; his best run this season came at Chester when a close second over 7.6f at the May meeting; good third at Hamilton last month (first run after a gelding operation); each-way shout.
runners.comment: Ran well here at the May meeting and again at Hamilton last month; each-way shout

runners.name: Miami Matrix
runners.spotlight: Promiment racer who is well drawn to attack; three creditable runs here for his new stable in 2026 but others appeal as being better treated.
runners.comment: Well drawn to attack but others appeal as being better treated

runners.name: The Strikin Viking
runners.spotlight: Group 3 win in Germany (6f, soft) last August; not at his best this year but the handicapper is cutting him some slack; stamina for 7f, even around here, has to be taken on trust.
runners.comment: Group 3 win in Germany in 2025; not at best in 2026 but handicapper relenting; 7f a query

runners.name: Korker
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run but he has dropped to a dangerous mark and his latest Newcastle run confirmed he retains a good chunk of ability, surging to the front 1f out but failing to see out the stiff 7f; this easier test should suit and he can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Latest Newcastle fourth was most encouraging; dangerous mark and he can't be discounted
runners.owner: Fine Claret Racing,Mrs Burke & C Wood

runners.name: The Angel King
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 4yo; three runs for Ian Williams have resulted in two heavy defeats either side of an eyecatching C&D effort in May; won't be far away if back at that level.
runners.comment: Two heavy defeats sandwich a good C&D run in May; not solid but the ability is there

runners.name: Palmar Bay
runners.spotlight: Won the corresponding race 12 months ago off a 10lb lower mark; as good as ever when fourth of eight at Wolverhampton (7f, Listed) in March but has found it tougher going since; apprentice's claim is useful but he still has little margin for error off this mark.
runners.comment: Won this race last year off 10lb lower; not yet built on his promising reappearance

races.race_name: J20 Classified Claiming Stakes

runners.name: Blue Prince
runners.spotlight: The last run wasn't his best (four ran) but he was bang there in his four previous races, all handicaps at 7f/1m; drops into a claimer on favourable terms and must have every chance; has run well here before.
runners.comment: Running well until last time; drops into a claimer on favourable terms

runners.name: Alpha Capture
runners.spotlight: Consistent since leaving Willie Mullins, performing well in handicaps from 6f to 1m; York last time wasn't necessarily a backward step as he wasn't beaten all that far in a big field after finding trouble in running; solid chance now into a claimer; first run here.
runners.comment: Done well in 6f-1m handicaps for his new yard and latest York run wasn't too bad

runners.name: Candonomore
runners.spotlight: Won races for two previous yards and was a close third on debut for current one (1m1f, good to firm); hasn't kicked on from there, including here two runs back when beating one home over 6f; drops into a claimer but these terms aren't easy.
runners.comment: In need of a revival; drops into a claimer but these terms aren't easy

runners.name: I Still Have Faith
runners.spotlight: All wins have been over further when hooded and he's 0-7 at about 7f (has placed form); hasn't really fired in any of his last three races but this is easier than he's accustomed to; unraced at Chester.
runners.comment: Hasn't fired in any of his last three races but this is easier than he's accustomed to
runners.owner: J Morley D Reynolds C Watkins & Partner

runners.name: Midnight Strike
runners.spotlight: Won on debut for Joseph O'Brien; his only effort of note in six starts for current yard (two here) was last month's selling win at Beverley (extended 1m) when odds-on in beating two rivals (in this first-time headgear); back in a handicap last time and was found wanting, albeit over 1m2f; others preferred.
runners.comment: Essentially regressive and his recent win came in a three-runner seller
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

runners.name: Calyxoh
runners.spotlight: Third in a C&D handicap last month but that's been about it since joining this stable; now visored and doesn't have obvious claims on these terms.
runners.comment: Third in a recent C&D handicap but looks inconsistent; these terms are difficult

races.race_name: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Cape Fear
runners.spotlight: No course form but acts on good and faster ground; it took six races to get off the mark, when odds-on over an extended 1m3f at Lingfield in June, and he proved very disappointing when a shade of odds-on for last month's handicap debut at Newmarket (1m4f; beaten 18l); now goes in cheekpieces and he could be given another chance, especially as the horse he beat in his novice has won since.
runners.comment: Goes in cheekpieces after quiet handicap debut; chance on the form of his novice win

runners.name: Secret Beach
runners.spotlight: Perhaps best over further but he was only nabbed late on over C&D last week and, although 1lb higher, Toby Moore rides him for the first time claiming 7lb; can be inconsistent but he's run three excellent races in defeat around here; solid chance.
runners.comment: Can be inconsistent but another good run in defeat here eight days ago

runners.name: Oman
runners.spotlight: Has competitive course form, including a respectable fourth over the extended 7f in June; this is more his trip but he needs to bounce back from two forgettable runs at 1m4f (here) and 9.4f (AW).
runners.comment: Capable handicapper but he needs to bounce back from two forgettable runs

runners.name: Saligo Bay
runners.spotlight: Progressive form under both codes last year included a 1m4f course win; quiet return to jumping at Cartmel two weeks ago but that was after a lengthy break and he's on better Flat mark than he is over hurdles.
runners.comment: Progressive form under both codes last year; quiet recent hurdle run; Flat mark is kinder

runners.name: Moon Beginnings
runners.spotlight: 0-8 since his winning debut here last September (7f); last two runs have also been here at about 7f and neither was wildly encouraging (in cheekpieces then an eyeshield); bit to prove, including stamina for this far.
runners.comment: 0-8 since his winning debut here last September; bit to prove, including stamina
runners.owner: Nbr30, Mike Owen & Rasio Cymru Racing

runners.name: Eagle Day
runners.spotlight: Exposed 6yo who excels at Wolverhampton where's he won five times and yet on turf he's 1-19; close fourth on his favourite patch 12 days ago and 4lb lower back on the grass, but he wouldn't be the percentage call on first visit here.
runners.comment: Better on the AW and he wouldn't be the percentage call on his first visit here

runners.name: Naples
runners.spotlight: Heavy-ground maiden winner for Paddy Twomey; hasn't got a lot going for current yard (four starts) and cheekpieces tried last time are soon removed; it could be that he'll show more when the ground softens up.
runners.comment: Hasn't got a lot going for current yard and might be one for when the ground softens

runners.name: Tiger
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who has raced seven times for Ian Williams and encouragingly the best of those efforts was his latest when beaten half a length from the back at Doncaster (1m4f, good to soft); back up 2lb; unraced on firmer than good; fair chance provided conditions don't hold him back.
runners.comment: Best run for this yard was the latest at Doncaster; chance if okay on this quicker ground

runners.name: Echalar
runners.spotlight: AW winner over 7f for previous yard off 3lb higher; signs of getting it together for Ian Williams, albeit those were Class 5 handicaps at Chepstow and over 1m; down 1lb and, if he can see out the trip, wouldn't be without hope.
runners.comment: Signs of getting it together for Ian Williams, albeit in Class 5s at 1m

runners.name: Farasi Lane
runners.spotlight: Has been around the block and mostly seen on the AW these days; he did win on debut for this yard at Ripon (1m, good; by a head) but then finished last at Sandown four days ago; unplaced in one previous run here.
runners.comment: Recent Ripon winner on yard debut but then finished last at Sandown; exposed

races.race_name: Bodhi Solutions - Facilities Management Front Runner Handicap

runners.name: Brighton View
runners.spotlight: Scored on handicap debut at Newbury in May and bounced back from a duff effort when running-on second to progressive rival at Doncaster (also 1m2f, good to firm) last month; could have untapped potential over this longer trip; respected.
runners.comment: Ran on well for second behind progressive rival last month; upped from 1m2f here

runners.name: Mr Bollinger
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on handicap debut (1m2f; only run in cheekpieces) but looked a different horse when winning five-runner C&D (good to firm) contest from the front ten days ago; enjoyed the run of the race that day but was nicely clear of the others with the odds-on favourite, and a 2lb rise could turn out to be lenient.
runners.comment: Won from the front over C&D ten days ago and recent 2lb rise could be lenient

runners.name: Shadow Brigade
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at sixth attempt, coming from off the pace to lead close home in first-time blinkers at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) ten days ago; still unexposed over middle distances and may have more to offer.
runners.comment: Came from off pace to score at Doncaster recently; still unexposed over middle distances

races.race_name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Keep Grating
runners.spotlight: Showed clear promise over 6f on first two starts and lost out only by a head when upped to 7f at Doncaster (good to firm) a fortnight ago; that form already gives him strong claims here and further progress is possible.
runners.comment: Went close when upped to 7f at Doncaster two weeks ago and has strong claims here

runners.name: Telegraphic
runners.spotlight: Took big step forward from debut run when easily drawing clear by over 7l at Brighton (7f, good to firm) last month; that wasn't a strong race but he's an obvious contender under penalty here.
runners.comment: Easily drew clear to win by over 7l at Brighton last month; obvious contender

runners.name: Javelot
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam 1m3f/1m4f AW winner (RPR 89), half-sister to winners Cemhaan (smart 1m-1m6f) and Moliwood (12.4f-2m); has fairly good standard to reach on debut but worth a check in the betting.
runners.comment: Third foal from a fairly useful 1m3f/1m4f AW winner; worth a check in the betting

runners.name: Strong Performance
runners.spotlight: First foal; unraced dam closely related to 1m 2yo winner Luzon Heights, half-sister to winners Alobayyah (useful 1m including 2yo), Alexej (7f/7.5f) and Exceedingly Regal (1m), out of 7f 2yo Group 3 winner; stable enjoying good season with 2yos.
runners.comment: Out of close relative of a 1m 2yo winner; stable enjoying good season with 2yos

runners.name: Pirates Paradise
runners.spotlight: 42,000euros yearling; eighth foal; half-brother to winners Promising (Group-placed 6f AW; RPR 103), Lethal Promise (5f-6f including 2yo/Listed; 102), Glen Force (1m-1m4f; 99), Kaser (8.6f-10.4f; 94) and Simple Man (5f/6f; 87); dam US 5.5f/6f winner; has nice pedigree but it's worrying to see cheekpieces fitted on debut.
runners.comment: 42,000euros yearling; nice pedigree, but it's worrying to see cheekpieces fitted on debut

runners.name: Spes Durat Avorum
runners.spotlight: 20,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Lazieelunch (1m/9.4f AW including 2yo; RPR 83), Renovatio Angel (7f 2yo; 74) and Kool Kid (bumper/jumps); dam 1m6f AW winner (79); trainer not prolific with newcomers.
runners.comment: Out of a fair 1m6f AW winner; trainer not prolific with newcomers

runners.name: Biscaysian
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; fourth foal; dam French 1m4f AW winner, half-sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Ocovango and two other winners; market support will bring him into the equation.
runners.comment: 30,000euros yearling; dam French 1m4f AW winner; market may guide on debut

runners.name: Sovereign Dawn
runners.spotlight: Last of ten on debut at Windsor (5f) in June and probably didn't achieve much when third of four in tactical race won comfortably by 2-9 favourite here (6f) last month; upped in trip again today.
runners.comment: Probably didn't achieve much when third of four in tactical 6f race here last month

runners.name: Cracking Idea
runners.spotlight: Made fairly encouraging debut when fifth of nine at Lingfield (7f, AW) three weeks ago but has a bit to find with the principals here and might be one for a bit further down the line.
runners.comment: Made encouraging debut on AW last month but has quite a bit to find with two of these

races.race_name: Bodhi - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Classified Stakes

runners.name: Valsharah
runners.spotlight: A maiden after 28 starts, with tendencies to start slowly and race too freely, but has made the frame on his last five appearances, including two seconds in this grade at Brighton (6f, good to firm) this summer; fine over 7f and a likely contender once again; has tried various headgear combinations this year; goes in just the refitted cheekpieces today.
runners.comment: 0-28 but has made the frame on his last five appearances and is a likely contender again

runners.name: Oh So Audacious
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key seasonal/stable debut when fourth in Brighton handicap in June but finished down the field in this grade at Lingfield (also 7f, good to firm) last month; now tries cheekpieces; not easy to predict.
runners.comment: Fair fourth in a handicap in June but well held since; now tries cheekpieces

runners.name: Aspire To Glory
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner for Alice Haynes; out of form for new stable this year (five runs) but took step back in right direction when respectable sixth in this grade at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) last month and may benefit from this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Out of form this year but latest run was a step back in the right direction

runners.name: Nicely Curved
runners.spotlight: Looked unlucky not to win or go close when third on turf return here (1m, soft) in June, and again ran well in this grade when third at Lingfield (7.6f, good to firm) last month; may not be ideally suited by this shorter trip but still features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Placed in this grade on last two outings and features prominently in calculations

runners.name: Girls Allowed
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage filly who made quite promising seasonal/handicap debut when fourth at Leicester (7f, good to firm) in May and may not have been suited by the soft ground when sixth (behind Nicely Curved) in this grade here (1m) in June; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Fourth on seasonal/handicap debut in May and had possible ground excuse last time

runners.name: Caitlin G
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all eight starts; belied 100-1 odds when fourth in this grade at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago, her second run for Micky Fenton, but needs to build on that performance here.
runners.comment: Belied 100-1 odds when fourth in this grade at Lingfield recently; needs to build on that

races.race_name: Bodhi Solutions - Constructing Champions Handicap

runners.name: Guest House
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to firm) on seasonal debut in April and was seemingly back in peak form when close third of four in tactical C&D contest ten days ago; not one to rely upon heavily but enters calculations.
runners.comment: C&D winner in April and seemingly back in peak form in tactical race here ten days ago

runners.name: Melting Snow
runners.spotlight: Just a respectable fourth when upped to 1m2f (from about 7f) for recent handicap debut at Beverley but didn't have ideal track position there; drops back to 1m with cheekpieces tried here; should still have potential.
runners.comment: Respectable fourth on handicap debut (1m2f); back in trip with cheekpieces added

runners.name: Daretobedifferent
runners.spotlight: Safely held an Newmarket on last two outings but this race is easier and she's now only 3lb higher than for breakthrough win at Nottingham (8.3f, good) in May; also suited by fast ground; dangerous if back on song.
runners.comment: Back in calmer waters after two Newmarket runs; player if judged on Nottingham win in May

runners.name: Okiru
runners.spotlight: A maiden after 12 runs but came from behind to go close in first-time blinkers at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) in June and also ran well when fourth at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) last month; could have a say.
runners.comment: 0-12 but has made the frame on both starts since blinkers were added in June (7f/1m)

runners.name: Bellini Spirit
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in her first two handicaps (5f/6f) but moves back up in trip and drops in grade here; still unexposed; worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: Well down the field in both handicaps (5f/6f); back up in trip; worth a glance in betting

runners.name: Esdaile
runners.spotlight: Showed some glimmers of promise in her qualifying races but was in rear throughout her recent handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) and clearly needs a much more dynamic performance here.
runners.comment: In rear throughout recent handicap debut (8.6f, AW); needs to big step forward

races.race_name: Bodhi Solutions - Commercial Fit-Out Challenge "Confined" Handicap (One Win Or Less In Flat Races)

runners.name: Nuptown Girl
runners.spotlight: Just held on to win tactical race at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) in June and seemed to respond well to first-time cheekpieces when clear second to revitalised rival over C&D (good to firm) on Tuesday; commands respect.
runners.comment: Makes quick reappearance after clear second over C&D on Tuesday; commands respect

runners.name: Risen Again
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on some of last year's form for Alice Haynes that includes a fast-ground C&D win but has not been competitive on any of four starts for new stable this season (cheekpieces refitted last time); considered only if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: C&D winner in 2025; well handicapped now but has not been competitive this year

runners.name: The Ubermensch
runners.spotlight: Consistent colt who opened account at tenth attempt, with narrow success in small field here (11.5f, good to firm) last month; nudged up only 2lb for that and this drop back in trip won't be a problem; ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Consistent colt who gained a narrow course win last month; in the thick of things again

runners.name: Big Alex Walmsley
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; has mixed record but gave good account when third of five in higher-grade race here (1m, good to firm; first-time hood) last month; could have a say if stamina holds out over this new trip.
runners.comment: Gave good account when third of five over 1m here last month; now tries new trip

runners.name: Cuban Girl
runners.spotlight: Free-goer who won over 1m for Andrew Balding last summer and looked back in good nick when running big race in defeat over that trip here (good to firm) in May; refused to settle and came last of five (albeit not beaten that far) when upped to 1m2f at Lingfield in June, though, and remains risky over this trip.
runners.comment: Ran big race over 1m here in May but refused to settle when upped to 1m2f in June; risky

races.race_name: Price Bailey LLP Norwich "Confined" Handicap (For Horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)

runners.name: Dragon God
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent for new stable this year and was close second off today's mark at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) on penultimate appearance; unlucky not to finish closer to the target when third of four there last time and has the services of Tom Marquand here; good chance.
runners.comment: Close second off this mark in June and had excuses last time; good chance

runners.name: Papa Don't Preach
runners.spotlight: 0-31 on turf but scored off 3lb higher on AW in December and returned from ten-week break with pretty good third in 0-70 grade at Doncaster (5f, good to firm) last month; major player in this grade.
runners.comment: Returned from break with pretty good third in higher-grade company last month

runners.name: Antiphon
runners.spotlight: Nothing like the force of old but rediscovered some form and ran well from the front when close third in Nottingham classified (5f, good to firm) last month; has possibilities if in similar mood again here.
runners.comment: Turned things around and ran well from the front when third at Nottingham last month

runners.name: Regal Guest
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was beaten at least 17l in all four 7f/1m races this year; cheekpieces (worn for last two starts) are discarded for this first attempt at 5f; has too much to prove.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden; badly out of form over 7f/1m this year; first run over 5f

runners.name: Nad Alshiba Snow
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who finished well down the field at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) on latest outing two months ago; needs subsequent wind op to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden who needs recent wind op to prompt a revival

runners.name: Mart
runners.spotlight: Won seven sprints when trained by Dylan Cunha and didn't run badly when tried over 1m here last month, after which he changed hands for 16,000gns; makes stable debut from a good mark but is on the downgrade now and 6f is probably his optimum trip; tongue tied for first time.
runners.comment: Makes stable debut from a good mark but is on the downgrade and would appeal more over 6f

runners.name: Surprise Again
runners.spotlight: Yet to show any worthwhile form after six starts (6f-1m); dropped in trip and fitted with a tongue-tie today.
runners.comment: Yet to show any worthwhile form after six starts (6f-1m); dropped in trip today

races.race_name: 168th Henkel-Preis der Diana - German Oaks (Group 1) (Fillies) (Turf)

runners.name: Lapotheose
runners.owner: Riviera Equine S A R L & Maurice Lagasse

races.race_name: Fritz Henkel-Preis (Group 3) (Turf)
Sky Sports Racing Prix Six Perfections - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)

runners.name: Queen Of The Day
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to Prix Jean Romanet winner Quisisana for the same ownership and trainer; made a winning debut at Saint-Cloud (7f, soft ground) from Woot Woot and improved on that to finish second over this C&D in a Listed race behind an odds-on market leader; solid claims.
runners.comment: Well bred filly who ran well over C&D last time; interesting

runners.name: Yuquot
runners.spotlight: More experienced than most and has shown a fine level of ability since her successful debut, twice finishing close behind subsequent Group 2 winner Tokaido in a Listed event and a Group 3; wasn't quite at her best at Mont-De-Marsan recently but step up in trip should bring about some extra.
runners.comment: Has plenty of good form already and just about sets the standard

runners.name: Nicely
runners.spotlight: Built on her debut second to shed her maiden status in comfortable style at Hamilton (6f, good to firm), drawing clear by over 4l under David Egan; steps up to 7f for her first start in Group company but enough in her pedigree to suggest she'll get this new trip.
runners.comment: Won well last time at Hamilton and should stay new trip upped in class

runners.name: Woot Woot
runners.spotlight: Beaten a head on debut at Saint-Cloud by Queen Of The Day (7f, soft) and then didn't need to repeat that level to win over that same C&D on good ground; closely matched with the Graffard filly on that meeting in June and should give a decent account.
runners.comment: Just behind Queen Of The Day on debut but won after; should give decent account

runners.name: Data
runners.spotlight: Just over 2l behind Flying Spur on debut (7f) at Saint-Cloud but since come out and won over a mile at Clairefontaine on good to soft; clear potential to post even bigger figures but the owner's retained rider appears to prefer Yuquot.
runners.comment: Won after being behind Flying Spur on debut; owner has two runners

runners.name: Flying Spur
runners.spotlight: Displayed plenty of progression from her debut at Saint-Cloud (6f, good) to win over 7f at the same track in June, when Data was over 2l back in second; won't have any problems with the trip, so should be thereabouts upped in class.
runners.comment: Beat Data over this distance when last seen and should be thereabouts

runners.name: Etoile D Armor
runners.spotlight: Didn't show lots on first two starts, recording RPRs on 47 and 32 but did much better when last seen finishing second at Le Touquet over 6.5f when a tongue-tie was applied; that will need improving upon, though, and others easier to fancy at this stage of their careers.
runners.comment: Ran better last time but more needed in this company

races.race_name: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)

runners.name: Light Of Dawn
runners.spotlight: Expensive breeze-up purchase, who won a four-runner novice at Carlisle (6f, soft) on debut before posting a much-improved effort when third in the Group 3 Albany Stakes (6f, good to firm) at Royal Ascot; well entered up and one to beat if at anything near that level today.
runners.comment: Finished third in a Group 3 at Royal Ascot last time; more to come

runners.name: Hinata Grey
runners.spotlight: Picked up a 6f conditions race on debut at Chantilly (very soft) and then ran respectably behind the classy Tokaido in a C&D Group 3 here about a month ago; will have more to come and Christophe Soumillon rides for first time.
runners.comment: Good effort both starts and Christophe Soumillon rides for first time

runners.name: Agamemnon
runners.spotlight: First three starts came over 5f, one an AW win and another when eighth in the Group 2 Norfolk Stakes at the Royal meeting, and then ran his best race upped to this trip for a Listed event at Newbury; open to more improvement over 6f.
runners.comment: Career best up to this trip last time; may do better

runners.name: Primetime Emmy
runners.spotlight: Related to plenty of winners and made a successful debut over C&D three weeks ago in a newcomers race for fillies having gone off an odds-on shot; has a Group 1 entry and would seem to be well thought of; interesting.
runners.comment: Won over C&D on debut and could be anything

runners.name: Jorolina
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred Mehmas filly, who was narrowly beaten on debut at Chantilly (5.5f, good to firm) before winning by a short-neck at the same course upped to 6f; Group 1 entered so should be capable of even better and stablemate of Primetime Emmy.
runners.comment: Narrowly beaten on debut but then won next time; can do better
runners.owner: Infinity 9 Horses, Ecurie Marzocco et al

runners.name: Aibar
runners.spotlight: Holds some big-race entries but finished second on debut over the C&D three weeks ago in a newcomers race for colts and geldings; should step up from that but this is a tough ask second-time out.
runners.comment: Runner-up on debut and tough task second-time out

runners.name: Kosuma
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred filly, who has won both races, a pair of 6f events at Saint-Cloud, one on good and one on good to soft, the last by 3l in good style; been off for a couple of months but another of these with a Group 1 entry; appears to be the choice of the owner's retained rider Maxime Guyon.
runners.comment: Won both races, the last by 3l, but been off for two months

runners.name: Valentina Bella
runners.spotlight: Won her first two, a 5f contest on good to soft before following up in a Listed race at Vichy (5f, soft); not disgraced in the Group 3 Albany Stakes (6f, good to firm) at Royal Ascot behind Light Of Dawn on first try over that trip, but work to do with that rival.
runners.comment: Won first two and then ran well at Royal Ascot; bit more needed

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)

runners.name: Symbol Of Majesty
runners.spotlight: Won first two starts before being beaten on handicap debut; ran significantly better after that in the Sandringham Stakes at Royal Ascot on first turf run, so respected up in trip and going into a Group race for the first time; William Buick has won on her before.
runners.comment: Goes up in trip for Group race debut; William Buick has won on her before

runners.name: Evita
runners.spotlight: Not won since 5l debut success as a 2yo but has shown steadily progressive form as she goes up in trip, and was just over 4l behind Diamond Necklace in the Prix de Diane when last seen; has to have sound claims dropped in class; now tried in cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Down in class after good run a month and a half ago; leading chance
runners.owner: Bradley Thoroughbreds LLC, O Ghrghar & C & Y Lerner

runners.name: Elle Eclipse
runners.spotlight: Only made her debut a month ago but posted a big effort by winning by more than 4l over 1m1f on good ground; trainer well known for not over-facing his horses, so encouraging sign to see her up into a Group 3 for her second start; could be anything.
runners.comment: Made winning debut recently; could be anything

runners.name: Etincelle
runners.spotlight: Chased home a Group horse on debut and then posted a big figure when landing a maiden at Longchamp (1m2f, good); not seen for three months, so hard to know what to expect, but good chance she has lots of improvement to come.
runners.comment: Posted a big figure when landing a maiden at Longchamp but not seen for three months
runners.owner: LNJ Foxwoods SC & Ecurie Des Monceaux

runners.name: Grande Baigneuse
runners.spotlight: Made a successful debut on the AW at Chantilly in February but wasn't seen then until ten days ago, when a close fourth at Vichy in a Listed event (1m2f, soft); should come on from that and be involved for a place at least; tongue-tie goes on.
runners.comment: Could comeback from a break recently; can improve

runners.name: Farflies
runners.spotlight: Dead-heated on debut over 7f at Strasbourg before a couple of fair efforts, albeit none that suggest she can win at this level; others far easier to make cases for despite cheekpieces going on.
runners.comment: Hasn't shown enough yet to suggest she can win a Group race

runners.name: Harmonize
runners.spotlight: Not seen since winning on her debut at Cagnes-Sur-Mer in January over 1m2f on a standard AW surface; hard to know what to expect on first turf start following an absence but James Doyle is an eyecatching jockey booking.
runners.comment: Not seen since winning debut in January; James Doyle is an eyecatching jockey booking
runners.owner: AP Racing SC, Bernard Giraudon & Mustapha Bekhti

runners.name: Lefteye
