runners.spotlight: Has done much better as a 3yo compared to her 2yo run and finished third in a 1m4f Listed event when last seen in June; drop in trip won't be a problem and looks the type to give a solid account.
runners.comment: Ran well over further last time and should cope with drop in trip

races.race_name: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)

runners.name: Blue Bolt
runners.spotlight: 3-3 this season and is an improved performer; followed her Duke of Cambridge win at Royal Ascot with a first top-flight success in the Falmouth, where she had too much foot for Precise; this flatter track won't inconvenience and she is the one to beat in a race lacking in depth.
runners.comment: Best effort to win the Falmouth last time and she's the one to beat

runners.name: Precise
runners.spotlight: Disappointed behind True Love in the 1,000 Guineas at Newmarket but made amends in the Irish equivalent, reversing placings with that rival; followed up in the Coronation Stakes at Royal Ascot but found Blue Bolt too quick in the Falmouth; this track could suit but a pb needed if she is to reverse placings with the Balding filly.
runners.comment: Irish 1,000 Guineas/Coronation Stakes winner but something to find with Blue Bolt

runners.name: Evolutionist
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on her juvenile form when winning the Group 3 Grotte (in front of a disappointing Green Spirit) on her reappearance and registered a pb when second to True Love in the 1,000 Guineas; didn't stay 10.5f in the Diane but, although faring better back at 1m in the Falmouth, has work to do to reverse placings with Blue Bolt and Precise.
runners.comment: Runner-up in the 1,000 Guineas at Newmarket but held on Falmouth form

runners.name: Godspeed
runners.spotlight: Fourth to Fallen Angel in this race last year and looked an improved performer when successful in a Listed event over 7f at Longchamp on her reappearance; below that level in the Duke of Cambridge at Royal Ascot and, although she's better than that, she has something to find with the principals.
runners.comment: Fourth in this last year; below that level on reappearance and more needed

runners.name: Moon Target
runners.spotlight: Smart juvenile who was placed in the Rockfel before disappointing in the Fillies' Mile, both runs in cheekpieces; posted a career-best effort with that equipment left off when fourth to Precise in the Coronation Stakes on her reappearance; should be better for that run and has minor place claims.
runners.comment: Respectable reappearance run in the Coronation Stakes; minor place claims

runners.name: Green Spirit
runners.spotlight: Best effort when close second to Diamond Necklace in last year's Marcel Boussac but beaten further by that rival in the Pouliches and didn't stay 10.5f in the Diane; return to 1m should suit but work to do if she's to compete with the two market leaders on these terms.
runners.comment: Shapes as though the return to this trip will suit but she'll have to improve

runners.name: Gaga Girl
runners.spotlight: Exposed performer who has won three of her 12 starts; ran to her best when winning a Listed event over C&D last time but she'll need a big jump forward if she's to figure at the finish.
runners.comment: Listed winner last time but good deal more needed

runners.name: Anakova
runners.spotlight: Turned in her best effort when beating Gaga Girl in a Listed event on testing ground at Longchamp in May; considerably more needed if she's to follow up in this company.
runners.comment: Listed winner when last seen at Longchamp in May; good deal more needed

runners.name: Majestic Oops
runners.spotlight: Has managed nine wins from 37 career runs; respectable third in an allowance Grade 2 at Churchill Downs on first run for current trainer two months ago; can't be ruled out.
runners.comment: Shouldn't be too far away; far from disgraced in May.

runners.name: Seismic Beauty
runners.spotlight: Has chalked up three wins from her last five; has scored over C&D; behind Om N Joy when third in May (Santa Anita) in an allowance Grade 2; stable going well a plus; strong contender as has some big wins on the CV.
runners.comment: Arguably the one to beat as has some big wins on the CV.

runners.name: Eunomia
runners.spotlight: Beaten sixth of seven in an allowance Grade 2 at Belmont At The Big A three months ago; has achieved four wins from 15 career runs.
runners.comment: No impression in May; has achieved four wins from 15 career runs.
runners.owner: St Elias Stables LLC & WSS Racing LLC

runners.name: Hey Jessie
runners.spotlight: A proven winner with a career wins-runs record of 4-13 but all her victories have been gained at a lower level; finished fifth but wasn't beaten too far (just under 4l) back down to 1m2f (Santa Anita) 50 days ago in an allowance listed; running on dirt for the first time; a few rivals look in good form so may have to settle for supporting role at best.
runners.comment: Hard enough to fancy as running in what looks to be a hot race.

runners.name: A Thousand Miles
runners.spotlight: Beaten 28l (Los Alamitos Race Course) four weeks ago when dropped to 6 1/2f in an allowance Grade 2; not always shown an awful lot since winning a black type at Zia Park in November and has done all her winning at a lower level; a lot on her plate here and unlikely to trouble the principals.
runners.comment: Facing a testing assignment and one to tread carefully with.

runners.name: Om N Joy
runners.spotlight: Track has proven suitable before; on target three times in her last seven outings; had two of these in arrears at Santa Anita in May when springing a surpise to score by just under 4l (went off 17-2) in an allowance Grade 2.
runners.comment: A few of these behind her two months ago; has winning form at this track.
runners.owner: Baker Stables LLC, Michael Golovko & Terrence J Scanlan

runners.name: Chasten
runners.spotlight: Good winner in a black type at Delaware Park 49 days ago; on target three times in her last four outings; no surprise to see her go well.
runners.comment: Entitled to respect; managed three wins in her last four outings.

runners.name: Bank Shot
runners.spotlight: Recent runs have been consistent; not beaten too far when third of six 49 days ago at Santa Anita in a Grade 3; she can be taken on.
runners.comment: May have to settle for supporting role; finished third 49 days ago.

runners.name: Simply Joking
runners.spotlight: Successful three times from ten career runs; respectable effort when second in an allowance Grade 2 at Santa Anita behind Om N Joy two months ago; has won in classy company before and warrants consideration.
runners.comment: Has won in classy company before and could be in the mix.

races.race_name: Glens Falls Stakes (Grade 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Inner turf)

runners.name: Survie
runners.spotlight: Ex-French mare who has several pieces of Group 1 form over middle distances, including in Saudi Arabia for this yard in February; however, she's been well below par in her first two outings back in Britain this spring, albeit with 1m on AW too sharp for her on the first occasion; much better effort when sixth in the Listed Wolferton Stakes at Royal Ascot last time; big chance if back to here best
runners.comment: Several pieces of Group 1 form in France and ran better last time

runners.name: Alluring Angel
runners.spotlight: Course winner; good second at Delaware Park behind Dona Clota 47 days ago in an allowance Grade 3; squeak despite being up in class.
runners.comment: This represents a step up in class but warrants consideration.

runners.name: Gezora
runners.spotlight: Well held in the New York Stakes behind Speed Shopper, two months ago on debut for trainer; seeking a sixth career win; step down in class big plus.
runners.comment: Warrants plenty of respect; has achieved five wins from 12 career runs.

runners.name: Speed Shopper
runners.spotlight: Well held in the New York Stakes back down to 1m1 1/2f two months ago; has chalked up three wins from her last five; track has proven suitable before; proven at a high level and ought to be in the mix.
runners.comment: Must go on the shortlist as has some big wins on the CV.
runners.owner: Gary Barber, Bridlewood Farm & Eclipse Thoroughbred Partners

runners.name: Massarat
runners.spotlight: Scored by a slim margin in an allowance optional claimer at Belmont At The Big A five weeks ago; has achieved three wins from 11 career runs.
runners.comment: Tight-margin winner last month; a proven winner with a career wins-runs record of 3-11.

runners.name: Storm Miami
runners.spotlight: Demoted third past the post at Delaware Park last month in an allowance Grade 3; has winning track form; wins have come at a lower level.
runners.comment: Others more persuasive as not in the habit of winning recently.

runners.name: Bellezza
runners.spotlight: A previous winner here and admirably consistent; promoted to third 47 days ago at Delaware Park in an allowance Grade 3; rates a likely contender.
runners.comment: She shouldn't be far away despite being up in class.

runners.name: Venencia
runners.spotlight: Second in an allowance listed at Churchill Downs in May; has gained all her wins at a lower level; steps up in grade so others more appealing.
runners.comment: Step up to allowance company will make life tougher so can be taken on.

runners.name: Dona Clota
runners.spotlight: Broke her duck at the sixth attempt in an allowance Grade 3 at Delaware; improving and worth a shot in this Grade.
runners.comment: A bunch of these behind her last month; seems to have stepped up on previous form the last twice.

runners.name: Favorite Memory
runners.spotlight: Finished sixth beaten just under 3l over 1m 1/2f at Churchill Downs (allowance Grade 3) two months ago;  is passed over despite this looking a little easier than last time.
runners.comment: Might find this company a little easier but unlikely to do better than a supporting role.

runners.name: Lady Firefoot
runners.spotlight: Held at Belmont At The Big A five weeks ago by Massarat when finishing last of six upped to 1m3f in an allowance optional claimer; has won here previously but at a lower level; could struggle.
runners.comment: Has been found wanting at this level before so one to tread carefully with.

runners.name: Bernietakescharge
runners.spotlight: Got home in front by just under 2l here over 1m1f (black type conditions); three from six here; tackling an extra 3f now and up in grade
runners.comment: Narrow winner two months ago; achieved three wins at this venue.
runners.owner: Robert D Rosenthal & Bradford H Bernstein
